page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-96-lssd is a high-memory server instance within the c4n family. It is equipped with 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 744.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include any graphics processing units (GPUs). While the basic description references 16 local SSDs, the local storage size is formally listed as none, indicating that primary storage must be provisioned externally.

With its high memory density and large dedicated core count, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial physical memory without the need for hardware acceleration. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4n-highmem-96-lssd offers a dense allocation of RAM per vCPU, making it suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and memory-bound scientific simulations. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, avoiding the resource contention typical of shared-core environments.
